scope: whole owning statement and complete seven-item proof
actual_comparative_record: Read the complete original statement and seven proof items after release, then the complete final proposed block and every literal guard. Rechecked the actual conductor D, identity minimal resolution, Picard pullback and blowup coefficient; all cubic, two-section and bisection cases; the exceptional-curve quotient and graph subdivision; the conductor-exponent test; the exact immersion sequence and Chern equations; all three-preimage triple-point counts; the direct conductor pushout; and the free graph group with e(C)=c+1-b. The missing all-supports hypothesis in the original P4.8 use is repaired by the single-support computation e(T)=6, e(D)=3t=2e(C)+t and e(S)=6-2t=t, retaining e(S)=2. Three draft arrow escapes and the elliptic-count wording were corrected before this final complete reread.
repair: P4.8 receiving hypothesis replaced by exact single-support calculation; theorem and stronger e(S)=2 case preserved
